title: Inverse Problems for the Return Map in the Class ( $\mathcal{O}_C$ ): Reconstruction and Identifiability
summary: We study the inverse problem associated with the return map $F$ on the boundary of a convex core $C$. By decomposing the return displacement into tangential and normal components, we derive an exact nonlinear reconstruction system for the unknown thickness $d$, yielding one-point uniqueness. Analyzing the linearization at fixed points introduces an operator $Q_*$: when $Q_* \neq 0$, the thickness and outer shape are uniquely recoverable via global propagation.
